5c5783af27592c8c.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ديار المدينه عن أخصائي توظيف للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور على وضع وتطوير سياسات وإجراءات التوظيف، بالإضافة إلى تحليل بيانات المرشحين وإدارة عملية التوظيف لضمان استقطاب الكفاءات المناسبة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة وتحليل ووضع السياسات والخطط المناسبة لتحديد واختيار أساليب ووسائل التوظيف للمناصب الشاغرة. تطوير إجراءات وبرامج التوظيف، بما في ذلك تحديد قنوات التوظيف الفعالة وتحديث قاعدة بيانات التوظيف، وتحديد نماذج الإعلان عن الوظائف الشاغرة. تحليل المعلومات والبيانات الخاصة بالمرشحين للوظائف، والتأكد من دقتها واكتمال جميع الوثائق والمستندات المطلوبة. ضمان إدخال جميع البيانات المتعلقة بطلبات المتقدمين للتوظيف في الحاسب الآلي وأرشفة الطلبات بشكل منظم. تلقي وتقييم طلبات التوظيف، واختيار المرشحين الأنسب للوظائف، وإجراء المقابلات معهم. إدارة بيانات المرشحين للوظائف وتقديم التوصيات لمديري الوحدات التنظيمية المعنية، بالتعاون والتنسيق مع الجهات ذات الصلة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالتوظيف، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال التوظيف. فهم عميق لسياسات وإجراءات التوظيف وأفضل الممارسات في هذا المجال. القدرة على تحليل البيانات والمعلومات بدقة. مهارات ممتازة في التواصل والتنسيق. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في المدينة المنورة، المملكة العربية السعودية. يعمل أخصائي التوظيف ضمن فريق متخصص يساهم في بناء الكفاءات البشرية للشركة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة.

5cab3b9ba7264714.description: About the Role Alfanar is seeking a Senior SAP PS Consultant to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role focuses on designing, implementing, and supporting SAP PS solutions specifically for CAPEX projects. The consultant will be instrumental in ensuring effective project lifecycle management, accurate cost control, seamless system integration, and compliance with financial standards. Key Responsibilities Design and configure SAP PS solutions based on defined business requirements. Define and manage Work Breakdown Structures (WBS), networks, activities, and milestones. Maintain project profiles and settlement rules within the SAP PS module. Configure CAPEX budgeting and Availability Control (AVC) functionalities. Monitor project budgets, commitments, and actual costs, supporting cost planning, tracking, and variance analysis. Integrate SAP PS with other key modules including FI/CO, MM, PM, and FI-AA. Enable Assets under Construction (AuC) processes and their settlement to fixed assets. Ensure compliance with financial controls and audit requirements. Support the end-to-end project lifecycle, from planning and execution to monitoring, reporting, settlement, and closeout. Conduct requirements gathering and fit-gap analysis, preparing functional specifications and documentation. Support various testing phases (Unit, Integration, UAT) and resolve identified defects. Provide post-go-live support, implement enhancements, and deliver user training. Mentor junior consultants and facilitate knowledge transfer within the team. Accountabilities and Performance Maintain updated soft and technical skills relevant to the job role. Perform planned activities to meet operational and development targets according to delivery schedules. Utilize resources effectively to achieve objectives within efficient cost and time parameters. Provide periodic reports detailing deviations and execution of planned tasks. Solve operational problems and escalate complex issues as required. Ensure quality requirements are met, developing effective quality control and processes. Coordinate well-defined written systems, policies, and procedures, seeking automation opportunities. Comply with relevant policies, procedures, and work instructions. Ensure compliance with safety, quality, and environmental management procedures within the defined work area. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of experience in SAP PS consulting. Demonstrated expertise in SAP PS configuration and implementation for CAPEX projects. Strong understanding of project planning, cost control, and financial integration processes within SAP. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role involves working within a professional environment focused on delivering robust SAP solutions for critical business operations.

5cc9258ac93ca2d5.description: About the Role Ultimate Peaks is seeking a Senior Microsoft Infrastructure & Exchange Engineer to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time role is central to maintaining the health, security, and continuity of the organization's core Microsoft platform, including Exchange Server 2019 (on-premises) in a hybrid configuration with Microsoft 365, Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS/DHCP, and associated identity and email-security layers. The position requires 5-10 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Install, configure, administer, and upgrade Microsoft Exchange Server 2019 on-premises, applying cumulative updates and security patches on a controlled schedule. Manage and maintain Exchange Hybrid with Microsoft 365, including configuration, free/busy, cross-premises mail flow, and directory synchronization health. Execute mailbox migrations (on-prem to/from Exchange Online) with zero-data-loss cutovers and tested rollbacks. Perform advanced Active Directory administration, covering domain services, sites, trusts, OU design, delegation, user authentication, and permissions. Design, implement, troubleshoot, and optimize Group Policy Objects (GPO), managing scope, precedence, security filtering, and drift control. Administer the enterprise email-security gateway/solution, including anti-spam, anti-phishing, malware protection, content filtering, and policy tuning. Manage the sender-authentication stack (SPF, DKIM, DMARC) from monitoring to enforcement, and oversee mail routing and threat protection. Apply knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, routing, switching, firewalls, VPNs, VLANs, and NAT to ensure messaging and identity are reachable and secure. Administer Microsoft 365, Entra ID (Azure AD), and Single Sign-On (SSO), including tenant configuration, conditional access, and application registrations. Develop and maintain PowerShell scripting and automation for provisioning, reporting, bulk operations, and repeatable runbooks. Provide senior-level escalation support for messaging, identity, and email-security incidents. Maintain up-to-date technical documentation, standard operating procedures, and as-built diagrams. Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery Ensure messaging and identity Business Continuity/Disaster Recovery (BC/DR) plans meet required recovery capabilities. Maintain, test, and document DAG failover, AD recovery, and Exchange/M365 restore procedures periodically. Participate in BC exercises and support Business Impact Analysis for messaging and identity services. Work Arrangement This role is based in Riyadh, with on-site and hybrid working arrangements in line with organizational policy. Standard working hours apply, with flexibility to support business needs. The engineer will participate in an on-call rotation for critical messaging, identity, and email-security incidents, including outside standard working hours. Major changes will be executed within approved maintenance windows, typically outside peak hours, with change-management sign-off. Performance Indicators Maintain high availability of messaging services and prevent outages through timely certificate management and patching. Respond to critical messaging and identity incidents within agreed targets, restore services promptly, and document root causes. Deliver mailbox migration waves on schedule with zero data loss and tested rollbacks. Keep systems patched in line with approved security baselines and remediate critical vulnerabilities within required timeframes. Achieve SPF/DKIM/DMARC enforcement and demonstrate a measured reduction in delivered phishing/spam with a controlled false-positive rate. Periodically test business continuity and disaster recovery procedures, documenting successful recovery tests. Maintain current technical runbooks and infrastructure documentation for all owned services.

5cddd27b804ea04e.description: About the Role Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking a Manager of Governance & Board Affairs with 5-10 years of experience, specifically within the healthcare sector. This full-time role involves acting as the primary coordinator for board governance, committee administration, and governance documentation for QHC, working in coordination with the QIC General Secretariat Office. The position ensures that all governance processes are well-planned, properly documented, timely, and aligned with applicable requirements. Key Responsibilities Coordinate the annual governance calendar, meeting schedules, agendas, board and committee papers, and related follow-up for the Board and its committees, in collaboration with the QIC General Secretariat Office. Prepare, circulate, and safeguard board and committee packs, ensuring timely and high-quality materials for decision-making. Maintain accurate records of key decisions, decision logs, and action trackers, ensuring actions are followed up and escalated as required. Proactively develop and maintain the annual plan for the QHC Board and subcommittees, including recurring agenda items, statutory requirements, key approvals, and reporting milestones. Governance Framework and Documentation Support the development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of governance frameworks, charters, policies, procedures, and related documentation for the Board, subcommittees, and QHC leadership governance. Coordinate governance-related approvals and documentation with relevant QHC functions. Own the coordination, drafting, review cycle, and version control of governance policies and procedures. Decision Governance and Reporting Maintain and routinely update the QHC Delegation of Authority, decision-rights matrix, and approval pathways for Board and management decision-making. Coordinate governance requirements and approvals supporting the Board, subcommittees, and leadership decision-making, ensuring clear ownership, decision status, and follow-up actions. Produce clear, concise, and decision-ready Board, subcommittees, and committee reports, including summaries of matters for noting, discussion, approval, and escalation. Ensure decisions and approvals are properly recorded, communicated, and followed up, with actions tracked and escalated where required. Maintain confidentiality and information-governance standards for board and sensitive material. Stakeholder Coordination Coordinate shareholder, executive, and functional inputs into QHC governance processes, ensuring submissions are complete, aligned, and ready for the relevant governance forum. Act as a central point of coordination for governance matters between QHC, QIC, executive stakeholders, and relevant assurance functions, while maintaining appropriate confidentiality and escalation protocols. Required Experience Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience, with a strong background in healthcare governance and board affairs. The role requires close collaboration with the CEO/MD, executive leadership, QIC as shareholder, Legal, Compliance, Finance, and other relevant functions to maintain clear governance interfaces and promote consistent reporting.

5cfb9a2f11d69077.description: Principal Consultant - Procurement & Supply Chain SNC-Lavalin Fayez Engineering is seeking an experienced Principal Consultant - Procurement & Supply Chain to lead its Procurement & Supply Chain (P&SC) consultancy offering in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. This role involves supporting complex procurement and supply chain activities across major engineering and infrastructure projects and programs. The successful candidate will operate with a high degree of autonomy, serving as the primary interface for internal and external clients on all P&SC consultancy elements in KSA. Role Overview The Principal Consultant will bring deep procurement and commercial expertise to develop sourcing strategies, lead complex negotiations, and provide trusted advice to senior project and business stakeholders. This position is pivotal in the development and growth of the P&SC offering, working closely with Regional Capability Leads to deliver world-class, innovative consultancy services. The role requires collaboration across multidisciplinary and matrix teams to address complex procurement challenges, manage commercial and supply chain risks, improve supplier performance, and deliver sustainable value for clients and the business. Key Responsibilities Engage with internal and external clients to expand the P&SC offering in KSA. Support P&SC leadership across the GCC region. Develop and implement procurement and sourcing strategies for complex projects, programs, and categories. Lead end-to-end procurement activities, including market engagement, tendering, evaluation, negotiation, award, and supplier management. Provide specialist procurement and commercial advice to project directors and senior stakeholders. Evaluate business requirements, market conditions, and supply chain risks to recommend effective procurement solutions. Identify opportunities for innovation, value improvement, cost optimization, and enhanced commercial outcomes. Lead complex negotiations with suppliers, contractors, consultants, and service providers. Partner with Commercial, Legal, Finance, and project teams to manage contractual and commercial risk. Apply sound judgment to complex procurement, contractual, and supplier challenges. Ensure procurement activities comply with governance, ethical requirements, and delegated authorities. Monitor market conditions, supplier capacity, and emerging supply chain risks, recommending appropriate strategies. Support the resolution of supplier performance issues, contractual matters, and disputes. Build trusted relationships with senior internal stakeholders, clients, and key supply chain partners. Influence stakeholders across multidisciplinary and matrix environments to achieve effective commercial outcomes. Develop and manage strategic supplier relationships and performance. Communicate complex procurement and commercial issues clearly and confidently. Challenge established approaches where alternative solutions could improve value, delivery, or risk. Lead procurement teams and/or significant procurement initiatives as required. Coach and develop procurement colleagues, sharing specialist knowledge and best practice. Monitor procurement performance against project objectives, budgets, programs, and relevant KPIs. Provide clear commercial insight, reporting, and recommendations to senior stakeholders. Promote collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement across the procurement function. Required Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of significant experience in procurement, supply chain, and/or commercial management within engineering, infrastructure, consultancy, PMC, EPC, construction, transportation, energy, or a comparable environment. Demonstrated experience leading complex sourcing, tendering, and contract negotiations. Strong commercial judgment and contract management capability. Experience managing strategic suppliers, contractors, and consultants. Strong understanding of procurement governance and commercial risk. Experience influencing senior stakeholders within complex, matrix organizations. Experience leading procurement professionals and/or significant functional initiatives. Strong communication, negotiation, and problem-solving capability. Experience with major projects or programs; GCC experience is advantageous. About SNC-Lavalin Fayez Engineering SNC-Lavalin Fayez Engineering, operating as AtkinsRéalis, is a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. The company connects people, data, and technology to transform global infrastructure and energy systems. Together with industry partners, clients, and a global team of consultants, designers, engineers, and project managers, SNC-Lavalin Fayez Engineering is committed to leading clients across various end markets to engineer a better future for the planet and its people.

5c9bb1172c2b4ee7.description: About the Role SACO, the Saudi Company for Hardware, is seeking an experienced and results-driven Digital Marketing Manager to lead its digital marketing strategy and execution. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and requires a professional with 5-10 years of relevant experience. The role focuses on driving online revenue, optimizing customer acquisition costs, and maximizing return on marketing investment through data-driven strategies. Role Context and Collaboration The Digital Marketing Manager will be responsible for overseeing various digital marketing functions, including performance marketing, paid media, e-commerce, mobile app acquisition, analytics, SEO, and marketing technology. This position involves close collaboration with internal teams such as Marketing, E-commerce, Commercial, CRM, and IT, as well as external partners, to deliver integrated digital campaigns that support SACO’s business growth and commercial objectives. Key Responsibilities Develop and execute digital and performance marketing strategies aligned with business objectives. Manage paid media campaigns across platforms including Google Ads, Meta, TikTok, Snapchat, YouTube, and Microsoft Ads. Optimize campaigns to improve ROAS, customer acquisition cost, conversion rates, online revenue, and overall marketing efficiency. Drive e-commerce growth and mobile app acquisition, engagement, and re-engagement initiatives. Lead digital analytics, attribution, conversion tracking, and performance reporting using GA4, GTM, Firebase, and other measurement platforms. Oversee tracking frameworks, including pixels, SDKs, Conversion APIs, server-side tracking, and attribution solutions. Develop and implement SEO strategies to improve organic visibility and traffic. Manage digital marketing budgets, forecasts, media allocation, and performance against financial targets. Collaborate with E-commerce, Commercial, CRM, IT, and Creative teams to deliver successful promotional and seasonal campaigns. Manage media agencies, technology vendors, and relationships with key digital advertising platforms. Identify new digital channels, technologies, audiences, and growth opportunities. Provide actionable insights and recommendations to improve marketing performance and business results. Qualifications and Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Digital Marketing, E-commerce, or a related field. Minimum of 5 years of experience in digital marketing, performance marketing, growth marketing, or e-commerce. Proven experience managing substantial digital advertising budgets. Retail or e-commerce experience is highly preferred. Desired Skills and Attributes The ideal candidate will be a strategic, analytical, and commercially minded digital marketing professional. This role requires the ability to translate data into actionable insights, lead high-performing campaigns, and deliver measurable business growth.

5c72de1cbc7b62f0.description: We are seeking a dynamic and results-oriented Showroom Sales Manager to lead our sales team and drive exceptional customer experiences. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing daily showroom operations, coaching sales staff, and ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction. Key Responsibilities: * Develop and implement effective sales strategies to achieve and surpass revenue goals. * Lead, motivate, and train a high-performing sales team to foster a customer-centric environment. * Oversee showroom operations, including inventory management, visual merchandising, and customer service standards.

5c883ea69ed7ca99.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الهلالي للتجاره والمقاولات عن مهندس مدني للانضمام إلى فريقها في الباحة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على الإشراف الهندسي وإعداد التصاميم والمخططات الإنشائية، بالإضافة إلى متابعة تنفيذ المشاريع لضمان مطابقتها للمواصفات الفنية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة طبوغرافية وجيولوجية الموقع الإنشائي، وتحليل نتائج اختبار فحص التربة. دراسة المتطلبات والمخططات المعمارية للمشروع بشكل دقيق. تحديد أعماق التأسيس اللازمة للمشروع وإجراء تحليل إنشائي متكامل لعناصره. إعداد التصاميم الإنشائية ومتابعة إعداد المخططات الإنشائية وتدقيقها. تدقيق جداول الكميات والمواصفات للمواد الإنشائية المستخدمة في المشاريع. الإشراف المباشر على تنفيذ المشروع لضمان مطابقة جميع الأعمال للمواصفات والمعايير المعتمدة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في مجال الهندسة المدنية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بنتائج الأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسبة تقدمها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الهندسة المدنية. القدرة على دراسة وتحليل البيانات الطبوغرافية والجيولوجية. مهارات قوية في إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الإنشائية. القدرة على الإشراف على تنفيذ المشاريع ومطابقة المواصفات. بيئة العمل يعمل المهندس المدني ضمن فريق شركة الهلالي للتجاره والمقاولات في مدينة الباحة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التواجد في الموقع حسب متطلبات المشاريع. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريقنا، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لمناقشة تفاصيل الدور.

5cbc31098e65e095.description: About the Role Lucid Motors Middle East is seeking an EHS Manager to lead Environmental, Health & Safety programs and activities for AMP-2 manufacturing operations in King Abdullah Economic City, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is responsible for establishing and maintaining a strong EHS culture, ensuring regulatory compliance, effective risk management, and the safe execution of manufacturing activities. The EHS Manager will collaborate with various functions including Manufacturing, Engineering, Facilities, Logistics, Maintenance, and HR to integrate EHS requirements into daily operations and new installations. Key Responsibilities Lead the implementation and continuous improvement of the site EHS Management System. Ensure compliance with applicable Saudi Arabian environmental, occupational health and safety, civil defense, and industrial regulatory requirements, as well as company EHS standards. Provide EHS leadership and direction across AMP-2 manufacturing operations, including General Assembly, Body-in-White, Paint, Stamping, Logistics, Facilities, Maintenance, and supporting functions. Lead workplace hazard identification, risk assessments, Job Safety Analysis (JSA), inspections, and EHS audits. Develop and implement corrective and preventive actions to eliminate or reduce workplace risks. Lead investigations of injuries, incidents, near misses, environmental events, and high-risk conditions, including root-cause analysis and corrective action tracking. Establish and monitor site EHS KPIs, leading and lagging indicators, and management reporting. Partner with Engineering and Manufacturing teams during equipment installation, commissioning, process changes, and production ramp-up to ensure EHS requirements are incorporated from the design stage. Drive contractor safety programs and ensure contractors comply with site EHS requirements. Oversee programs related to LOTO, machine safety, confined spaces, working at height, electrical safety, chemical safety, ergonomics, material handling, PPE, and permit-to-work systems. Support environmental compliance programs covering waste management, hazardous materials, emissions, spill prevention, and environmental controls. Partner with Emergency Response and site stakeholders to maintain effective emergency preparedness and response programs. Lead EHS communication, training, awareness campaigns, toolbox talks, and leadership engagement initiatives. Coach managers and supervisors on their EHS responsibilities and promote a culture where safety ownership is embedded within operations. Support occupational health and industrial hygiene programs, including exposure assessments and ergonomic risk management. Conduct regular management reviews and communicate significant risks, trends, and improvement opportunities to site leadership. Support implementation and maintenance of ISO 45001 and ISO 14001 management systems. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of experience in Environmental, Health & Safety roles. Automotive or high-volume manufacturing experience is preferred. Experience with new factory launches and production ramp-up. Experience managing EHS programs across multiple manufacturing shops or operational areas. Knowledge of robotics, automation, machine guarding, manufacturing equipment, and material handling systems. Experience working with government agencies and regulatory authorities in Saudi Arabia. Strong experience in incident investigation, root-cause analysis, auditing, and corrective-action management. Work Environment This role is based at the AMP-2 manufacturing operations in King Abdullah Economic City, Makkah, Saudi Arabia, and requires full-time commitment. The EHS Manager will work closely with various internal departments to ensure a safe and compliant manufacturing environment.

5c06da7703091745.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة السلام أسك عن مهندس تقنية معلومات للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور على دراسة احتياجات العملاء من الأجهزة والبرمجيات، وتطويرها، وفحصها، وتركيبها، بالإضافة إلى تشخيص الأعطال ومعالجتها. هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية متابعة وتقييم عمليات جمع وتحليل البيانات، وتطوير وسائل وأساليب التحليل والتصميم بناءً على التقييم. البحث عن أحدث وسائل وأدوات البرمجة والفحص والتركيب المناسبة، ومراقبة دورة تطوير البرمجيات. تطوير وفحص وتركيب التجهيزات الحاسوبية والبرمجيات لضمان الأداء الأمثل. تشخيص أعطال التجهيزات الحاسوبية والبرمجيات ومعالجتها بفعالية. تطوير برامج الصيانة الوقائية ومتابعة تنفيذها لضمان استمرارية العمل. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية المستمرة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب تقدمها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال تقنية المعلومات أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على دراسة احتياجات العملاء من الأجهزة والبرمجيات وتلبيتها. معرفة جيدة بتطوير وفحص وتركيب التجهيزات الحاسوبية والبرمجيات. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات قوية في تشخيص أعطال التجهيزات والبرمجيات ومعالجتها. القدرة على إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة وعرضها ومناقشتها. مهارات تحليلية ممتازة لتطوير وسائل وأساليب التحليل والتصميم. القدرة على البحث عن أحدث التقنيات والأدوات المناسبة. بيئة العمل يعمل مهندس تقنية المعلومات في شركة السلام أسك بالمدينة المنورة ضمن فريق متخصص، في بيئة عمل ديناميكية تتطلب مواكبة التطورات التقنية المستمرة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل. التقديم للراغبين في التقديم، يرجى إرسال السيرة الذاتية. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لمناقشة تفاصيل الدور.

5c095821d8fa32b2.description: About Proger *** Proger is a global engineering and management firm with over 70 years of experience, recognized as a leading independent engineering company in Italy and established internationally. The company integrates Italian expertise in management, engineering, and security to deliver sustainable, multidisciplinary projects for public and private clients. Proger operates across Europe, Central Asia, Africa, and the Middle East, focusing on large-scale infrastructure, urban development, and energy transition projects. Proger is committed to equal opportunities, diversity, and gender equality in its selection and recruitment processes. Role Overview: BIM Coordinator Proger *** is seeking a BIM Coordinator to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position requires 5-10 years of experience and will support the BIM Integration Lead within the Program/Interface Support Consultant (PISC) services for the Expo 2030 Riyadh program. The role focuses on verifying BIM models, performing clash detection, and ensuring effective interface management in line with the Client’s EIR and Programme-wide BIM Execution Strategy. Key Responsibilities Verify Lead Design Consultant (LDC) and contractor models (buildings and infrastructure) against the EIR, PISC BIM Execution Plan, required LOD/LOI, PBS coding, and asset tag requirements. Support periodic federation of the site model and conduct clash tests according to exchange schedules, tolerances, and priorities, issuing clash reports at project milestones. Differentiate discipline clashes from interface clashes between packages, registering the latter as Interface Points in Coreworx and linking clash closure to related Interface Control Forms (ICF). Check for the presence and consistency of Interface Point tags (IP-[package]-[discipline]-[nnnn]), status, and ICF references in models at each delivery, utilizing automated checks. Track clash and issue resolution with LDCs and contractors to ensure clash-free models before design freeze. Verify that Interface Points shown on 2D drawings correspond with those in the federated model and report any discrepancies. Prepare federated model views, sections, and snapshots for ICFs and Interface Close-out Certificates (ICC), and verify as-built models against ICFs. Attend weekly Design Integration Meetings and bi-weekly Package Interface Coordination Meetings with updated clash reports, and support the weekly Interface Working Group. 5c4f9ed6fbcd7de1.description: Company Overview: Join a highly reputable AEC consultancy with over 40 years of experience in delivering iconic projects across hospitality, commercial, industrial, and mixed-use sectors. Should have good experience with communications circuits and Ethernet cabling (structured copper cabling and fiber optic cables). Proficient in Windows server and Linux configuration and troubleshooting. Proficient in MS Office. Basic knowledge of electrical and mechanical components like Online Double Conversion UPS, Dynamic Rotary UPS, medium/low voltage circuits, and chilled water-cooled HVAC systems.

5c2692262abe2d49.company_name: شركة تنمية الإنسان | Human Development Company
5c2692262abe2d49.description: نبحث عن أخصائي تربية خاصة ملتزم ليكون جزءاً من فريقنا، لديه شغف بمساعدة الطلاب على تحقيق إمكاناتهم الكاملة. ستكون مسؤولاً عن تطوير وتنفيذ خطط فردية للطلاب ذوي الاحتياجات الخاصة، وتقديم الدعم الأكاديمي والسلوكي اللازم. بالإضافة إلى ذلك، ستتعاون بشكل وثيق مع أولياء الأمور والمعلمين لضمان بيئة تعليمية داعمة وشاملة. مهام الوظيفة: * تقييم احتياجات الطلاب وتحديد الأهداف التعليمية الفردية. * تصميم وتنفيذ برامج تربوية علاجية متخصصة. * تقديم الدعم والإرشاد للطلاب في الجوانب الأكاديمية والسلوكية والاجتماعية. * التواصل الفعال مع أولياء الأمور والمعلمين لمتابعة تقدم الطلاب. * توثيق وتقييم أداء الطلاب بشكل دوري.

5c333f23d578b0a1.company_name: شركة تنمية الإنسان | Human Development Company
5c333f23d578b0a1.description: المهام والمسئوليات: المهام والمسئوليات الرئيسية: معرفة التاريخ الصحي والنفسي للمستفيد ومتابعة أي تطور أو ما يستجد عليه. تقييم المستفيدين 3 تقييمات (بداية كل فصل - منتصف كل فصل - نهاية كل فصل) حسب المواعيد المقررة لذلك. تطبيق الإجراءات الاستباقية لالتحاق مستفيدي خدمة العلاج الطبيعي على كافة المستفيدين الملتحقين بالخدمة ورفع النتائج للمشرف/ة. الالتزام بعدد الحالات 20 حالة أسبوعياً من نصاب الحالات التابعة للوزارة. اتباع وتطبيق جدول الجلسات بانتظام. الالتزام بتعويض المستفيدين في حال غياب الأخصائي/ة أو في حال غياب المستفيد. الالتزام بسياسة الشركة فيما يخص الخطط والتقارير. متابعة حالة المستفيد ومناسبة الخطط والنقاش مع المشرف/ة. إعداد تقرير وصفي عن التدخل الذي تم في الجلسات التدريبية للحالات الاستثنائية والحضور والمشاركة في مؤتمر نقاش حالة المستفيد. استلام العهد والأدوات والمحافظة عليها والتبليغ في حال التلف أو الصيانة. إدخال التدريبات المنزلية للأهل على نظام ريهادوكس (عدد 2 إلى 3 تدريب يومياً). رصد الجلسات التدريبية على نظام ريهادوكس (3 أهداف عن كل جلسة فعلية واحدة). توثيق الجلسات المعطاة في نموذج تحضير الجلسات الموحّد داخل العيادات. إعطاء جلستين تدريبيتين لكل مستفيد وإضافة جلسة تكثيفية لمستفيد ضعيف الأداء عند غياب مستفيد آخر. تنفيذ جلسة متابعة السلامة داخل العيادات التابعة للخطة الإدارية على نظام ريهادوكس يومياً. تنفيذ جلسة متابعة البيئة التدريبية التابعة للخطة الإدارية على نظام ريهادوكس مرة واحدة أسبوعياً. توثيق الجلسات المعطاة في النموذج المعتمد داخل الفصل. متابعة غياب المستفيدين وتبليغ المشرف/ة. مناقشة الأهداف المشتركة مع مختصي الفصول والعيادات الأخرى لتحقيق أقصى فائدة ممكنة من الخطة التأهيلية. تفعيل دور الخدمات العيادية داخل الفصول ومتابعة التنفيذ مع مختصي الفصول وتوثيقه في النموذج المعتمد لذلك. تحديث ملف الإنجاز وإضافة الدورات والفعاليات وأوراق العمل المنفذة مع المستفيدين خلال الجلسات التدريبية. تعبئة نماذج الخطط التشغيلية الموجودة على البورد داخل العيادات حسب الأحداث المذكورة فيها. استقبال حالات الحساب الخاص والدعم المسجلة في الخدمة حسب توزيع الحالات المعتمد من قِبل المشرف/ة (النصاب يشمل فقط المستفيدين الحكوميين التابعين للوزارة). متابعة مستجدات الوضع الصحي للمستفيدين مع القسم الاجتماعي والتمريض بشكل دوري. الالتزام بحضور الدورات التدريبية والاجتماعات المعلنة من قِبل الشركة. حضور الفعاليات التي تسهم في تحسين صورة المركز وتبرز دور القسم ودمج المستفيد في المجتمع. المختص ملزم بكل ما ورد في لوائح الشركة والمركز وكل ما يكلف به من المشرف/ة من مهام. التعاون والتفاعل مع روح الفريق. الالتزام بساعات العمل. الكفاءات والمهارات: المؤهلات العلمية: بكالوريوس علاج طبيعي. تصنيف هيئة التخصصات الصحية. المهارات الشخصية: القدرة على إدارة الجلسات التدريبية بفعالية. مهارات حل المشكلات واتخاذ القرارات بعد أخذ اعتماد المشرف/ة. مهارات تنظيمية قوية وإدارة الوقت. القدرة على العمل تحت الضغط والتعامل مع التحديات الميدانية. الخبرات العملية: (فارغ في النص المرفق) المهارات التقنية: إجادة استخدام الحاسب الآلي وبرامج Microsoft Office والتطبيقات التقنية. المهارات التواصلية: مهارات ممتازة في التعاون والتفاعل مع الفريق التأهيلي. المحافظة على سرية المستفيدين (تم تصحيح "سر المستفيدين" لتلائم السياق المهني).

5c2e78e801a75d95.description: Overview: Qiddiya Investment Company is pioneering entertainment and leisure development in Saudi Arabia. We are seeking a visionary and results oriented Senior Director - Entertainment Strategy to join our team. In this crucial role, you will drive the strategic direction of our entertainment assets and initiatives, ensuring we create memorable and captivating experiences for visitors. Key Responsibilities: 1. Support the Senior Executive Director of Entertainment Strategy in the development and execution of the overarching entertainment asset class strategy to ensure achievement of portfolio and assets’ ambition, vision and objectives. 2. Oversee design (pre-concept and concept) and early development stages of new entertainment assets to ensure alignment with Qiddiya’s entertainment offering and financials targets. 3. Lead research and delivery of new entertainment concepts to be integrated into Qiddiya City’s entertainment portfolio of assets; understand value proposition, prepare feasibility assessments and high-level implementation roadmap. 4. Manage contracted vendors, IP licensors, and other third parties to ensure that deliverables are in line with the overall project vision, offering, and relevant briefs (strategy brief and/or development brief) 5. Develop initial go-live strategies (operating model, pricing, sales and marketing, manpower planning, etc.) and provide implementation support to other functions across Qiddiya. 6. Prepare presentations and other supporting material required for seeking relevant approvals; Qiddiya Stage governance framework, Senior Management and Board of Directors. 7. Work closely with Qiddiya Entertainment Business Unit and other stakeholders to ensure efficient delivery of new projects and overall alignment to directives received from Senior Management and Board of Directors. 8. Establish and monitor key projects’ KPIs covering development, business, financial and operational plans to ensure alignment with project vision. 9. Prepare and monitor annual budgets, hiring plans, strategic and implementation plans of relevance to the Entertainment strategy function. Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance or a related field. At least 15 years of experience in entertainment strategy, asset management, or related domains. Comprehensive benefits package

5c57f3b70e210771.job_title: QS - Quantity Surveyor for Scaffolding Department
5c57f3b70e210771.description: ABIS is seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Quantity Surveyor (QS) for our Scaffolding Department. The successful candidate will be responsible for managing and controlling costs related to scaffolding projects, preparing accurate quantity take-offs, cost estimates, and budget reports. You will collaborate closely with project managers, engineers, and procurement teams to ensure cost efficiency and adherence to project budgets. This role requires expertise in scaffolding materials, labor, and equipment costs, as well as strong negotiation and communication skills to liaise with contractors and suppliers. Responsibilities Prepare and verify quantity take-offs for scaffolding materials and labor. Develop cost estimates and budgets for scaffolding projects. Monitor and control project costs, identifying and reporting variances. Review subcontractor quotations and contracts related to scaffolding works. Collaborate with project teams to ensure cost effectiveness and value engineering. Maintain accurate records and prepare regular cost reports. Assist in procurement activities and contract negotiations. Ensure compliance with company policies and industry standards. Bachelor's degree in Quantity Surveying, Civil Engineering, or related field. Minimum 5 years of Quantity Surveying experience, preferably in scaffolding or construction projects. Strong knowledge of scaffolding materials, methods, and industry standards. Proficiency with quantity surveying and cost estimation software. Excellent analytical, negotiation, and communication skills. Ability to work effectively in a team and under pressure. Familiarity with Saudi Aramco standards is a plus.

5c0575c5c5b8b564.description: Capitex is partnering with leading financial institutions and consultancies across the UK and Middle East to deliver critical financial crime transformation projects. We are seeking experienced Fircosoft Screening Specialists to support system tuning, optimisation, and effectiveness reviews across sanctions and name screening platforms. This is an excellent opportunity to work on high-impact regulatory projects , improving screening efficiency while maintaining robust risk coverage. Key Responsibilities Perform tuning and optimisation of Fircosoft screening systems Review and enhance screening rules, thresholds, and scenarios Reduce false positives while maintaining regulatory compliance Conduct effectiveness testing and validation of screening controls Support model governance and documentation aligned to regulatory expectations Analyse screening outputs and recommend improvements to detection logic Collaborate with stakeholders across compliance, technology, and operations Contribute to ongoing financial crime transformation programmes Proven experience working with Fircosoft solutions (e.g. Firco Continuity, Firco Trust, Firco Screening) Strong understanding of sanctions screening and name screening frameworks Hands-on experience in system tuning, optimisation, and calibration Experience reducing alert volumes while maintaining risk sensitivity Solid knowledge of AML / Financial Crime regulations and best practices Experience within banking or financial services environments Strong analytical and problem-solving skills Ability to work in fast-paced, project-driven environments Experience with transaction monitoring or broader FCC systems Exposure to regulatory reviews, audits, or model validation Prior consulting or project-based experience Access to top-tier financial services clients Highly competitive day rates / packages Opportunities across multiple international locations Long-term project potential and repeat engagements

5ce48d293616a014.description: We are seeking a highly skilled Chemical Engineer to support process design, optimization, and technical operations within our oil and gas facilities. The ideal candidate will contribute to safe, reliable, and efficient production by applying advanced engineering principles to refining, petrochemical processing, or upstream production systems. Responsibilities Develop and update PFDs, P&IDs, and process simulations. Optimize plant processes to improve production, energy use, and cost efficiency. Troubleshoot operational issues and support daily plant activities. Participate in HAZOP, PHA, and safety compliance activities. Prepare technical specifications and support project engineering tasks. Monitor key process parameters and provide performance reports. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering (Master’s a plus). 3–7 years experience in oil & gas, refinery, or petrochemical plants. Proficient in process simulation tools (Aspen HYSYS, Aspen Plus). Strong knowledge of process safety and industry standards (API, ASME). Good communication and problem-solving skills. Salary is not a constraint ,company is looking for right candidate .

5c44fd98c7254f48.company_name: Six Flags Qiddiya City and Aquarabia
5c44fd98c7254f48.description: As part of our ongoing recruitment process, we are building a CV pool for future opportunities in the Park Services department at Six Flags Qiddiya City and Aquarabia. If you have a passion for providing exceptional guest experiences and are interested in joining our team, please submit your CV along with a cover letter specifying your areas of expertise and the type of role you are interested in. Key Responsibilities: Ensure cleanliness and maintenance of park grounds and facilities Perform routine cleaning tasks such as trash collection, restroom maintenance, and sweeping Assist with park set-up and tear-down for events and attractions Monitor and replenish supplies in restrooms and other public areas Provide assistance to guests by answering questions and providing directions Assist in managing lost and found items Promote park policies and regulations to ensure the safety and satisfaction of guests Collaborate with other departments to address guest needs and resolve issues Adhere to all safety protocols and procedures Requirements: Prior experience in a customer service or hospitality role is preferred Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and handle multiple tasks Excellent communication and interpersonal skills Attention to detail and commitment to cleanliness Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays Prior experience in a customer service or hospitality role, ability to work in a fast-paced environment and handle multiple tasks, excellent communication and interpersonal skills, attention to detail and commitment to cleanliness, ability to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays
